verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right flow: logo and sale ribbon, then the phone, then the headline, subhead and CTA stacked in the right column. However, the phone runs almost to the top and bottom edges, the logo is tiny, and the legal line is jammed under the CTA and is too small to read. B's bottom row is badly cramped: the subhead wraps into an awkward two-line '25% off on / June 21.', and the four-line legal block, almost as prominent as the subhead, is pressed against the right edge. On top of that, the sale ribbon is cropped at the left edge and the decorative circles clutter the top-left corner beside the logo.
